alt.text: The cabin on final approach. Through the forward window the landing pad marked Keep clear comes up fast with a sea lion sitting on it. There is a thump and a jolt of turbulence; the overhead bins jump and the passengers start. Afterwards the sea lion sits dazed, unhurt, as the fasten-straps sign blinks.
